name: Guiding Shot
body:
When you’re lost and don’t know which way to go you never fear. Through your connection with the arcane, you are able to know precisely where you want to go. By firing an arrow into the air, you can be directed toward any location on the planet.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level Arcane Archer

Benefit: Three times per day, you can fire an arrow straight into the air and name a location. After the location is named, the arrow will turn and point in the direction of the named location before falling back down to the ground.
